name: epitech
description: The Epitech C coding style in VS Code: a Banana-proof formatter, Banana's reports as you save, hints for what only graders check, one-click fixes, function and nesting meters, Criterion tests with coverage, project scaffolding and a whole-project check. Unofficial.

epitech.diagnostics.enabled.description: Run Banana (epiclang) on C files when they're opened or saved.

epitech.diagnostics.command.description: The Banana checker. Include flags come from compile_commands.json or the project's include/ directory.

epitech.diagnostics.args.description: Arguments given to the checker before the include flags and the file.

epitech.format.enabled.description: Format C files and headers in the Epitech style (clang-format 21 or later plus the passes Banana needs).

epitech.budget.functions.description: Show "13/20 lines · 2/4 args" after each function's signature (C-F4, C-F5).

epitech.budget.depth.description: Show the nesting depth and branch count of control statements (C-C1).

epitech.budget.file.description: Show the file's function counts in the status bar (C-O3).

epitech.scaffold.cc.description: CC in the Makefiles of new projects.

epitech.scaffold.cflags.description: CFLAGS of new projects; empty for no CFLAGS line.

epitech.scaffold.debugCflags.description: Flags `make debug` adds in new projects; empty for no debug rule.

epitech.scaffold.errorFile.description: Give new programs src/print_error.c and the part of libmy it uses.

epitech.hints.enabled.description: Hints for what Banana doesn't check (graders do): magic numbers, functions that could be static, const pointers, size_t, naming.

epitech.hints.severity.description: How hints show: faint dots (hint), or in the Problems panel (information, warning).

epitech.hints.magicNumbers.description: C-G9: numbers that deserve a name.

epitech.hints.magicNumbersAllow.description: Numbers never flagged (84 is Epitech's error exit code).

epitech.hints.static.description: C-A4: functions only their own file uses (asks git).

epitech.hints.types.description: C-A1 and C-A2: pointers to data never modified, ints holding lengths.

epitech.hints.naming.description: C-F2, C-O4, C-V1: names without a verb, vague file names, typedef and macro names.

epitech.makefile.enabled.description: Check Makefiles: header, 80 columns, trailing spaces, empty lines.

epitech.updates.check.description: Check once a day for a new version of the extension (epitech-toolkit also updates it weekly).

walkthroughs.title: Epitech Coding Style
walkthroughs.description: Set up the tools, start a project, and let the editor keep it Banana-clean.

steps.title: Install the tools
steps.description:
The formatter needs clang-format 21 or newer; Banana's reports need epiclang.
[Open the setup guide](https://github.com/cempack/epitech-toolkit#readme)

steps.title: Start a project
steps.description:
Makefile, header, main.c, an error file with libmy, a Criterion test and a .gitignore.
[New Project](command:epitech.newProject)

steps.title: Write: format, meters, hints
steps.description: Saving formats the file. Meters count lines, parameters and depth; hints flag what graders check.

steps.title: Fix with the light bulb
steps.description: Ctrl+. on a report: (void), declarations to the top, one statement per line, switch, const, static, macros.

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.description:
Criterion tests appear in the Testing view, with coverage.
[Open the Testing view](command:workbench.view.testing.focus)

steps.title: Check before you push
steps.description:
Every tracked file, the Makefiles and the repository rules.
[Check the Project](command:epitech.checkProject)
